neighbours.label: places in British Columbia (Vancouver and its suburbs, Whistler, Kelowna, Kamloops, the Fraser River); nearby places in Washington State stay quiet

The ski resort at Whistler opened early this year.
A new SkyTrain station opened in Burnaby.
Hikers climb the Grouse Grind above North Vancouver.
Salmon return to the Fraser River every autumn.
